sebab: M5: harga naik dari zon DEMAND bawah dan membentuk HIDDEN BASE (3588.70 – 3591.59) sebelum melonjak.
BREAK: candle besar 12:31 tembus paras 3596.32. Struktur M1 dah break ke atas.
Harga naik sampai SUPPLY besar (3599.52 – 3606.60) dan SUPPLY kecil (3598.47 – 3599.92), lalu ditolak turun.
Retracement ke bawah BREAK, dan sekarang harga kembali masuk ke HIDDEN BASE, iaitu tempat pembeli masuk sebelum break.
BUY di wick atas HIDDEN BASE (3591.59). SL 60 pips (3585.59) di bawah base. Sasaran ke arah BREAK 3596.32 dan SUPPLY.
sig035.sebab_en: Price built a hidden base at 3588.70 to 3591.59, then broke above 3596.32. It was rejected at supply and has now pulled back into the hidden base, where buyers stepped in before the break. Buy at the top of the hidden base, with the stop loss below the base.
